# Deoit — Browser-Based IDE

> Deoit is a browser-based IDE for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with syntax highlighting, autocomplete, file explorer, and live preview. No setup required.

## What is Deoit?

Deoit is a browser-based IDE for building with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It features syntax highlighting, smart autocomplete, a file explorer, live preview, and a built-in console — all without any local setup.

### Key Features
- Syntax highlighting for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, Markdown
- Smart autocomplete with 500+ built-in keywords
- File explorer with multi-file project support
- Live preview panel (no page refresh)
- 81+ free lessons covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, React, and dev tools
- Chrome extension for quick access
- Embeddable widget for blogs and documentation
- PWA support (installable as desktop app)
- Dark theme editor interface
- No sign-up, no ads, no tracking
